back:
1) Very concise
2) Relatively reliable (accounting-based)
3) Easy to aggregate and compare
4) Inexpensive and simple to compute

front: 4 limitations of purely financial measurement systems
back:
1) Partial / inappropriate view of performance
2) No causes of discrepancies → little guidance on corrective action
3) Short-termism
4) Poor at predicting future performance

front: Why little guidance on corrective action?
back: Because they measure performance concisely, financial indicators do not reveal the causes of gaps.

front: Why poor at predicting the future?
back: They measure the financial consequences of actions already taken (backward-looking).
